# API reference

Every help topic in the package, generated from its help pages. In R, the
same text is available with `?name`.

## Tests of the variance

Each test returns an `htest` object, whose fields `test_results` documents. The tests are grouped by the family they belong to.

## Model checks

Checks of the fitted model that are not tests of the variance: the functional form, collinearity, influence and the fit itself. They are listed apart so that they are not mistaken for heteroscedasticity tests.
